methodology.application: real createApp Express routes and Mongoose models; no server.js worker startup
methodology.database: generated default-prefix isolatedDatabase() only, schema indexes created in fixture database, then removed
methodology.cold: catalogCache.clear() before each sample; MongoDB and operating-system caches are not cleared
methodology.warm: one untimed priming request then sequential full-body reads with persistent HTTP connection reuse
methodology.auth: public endpoints anonymous; gated catalog endpoints use actual login of synthetic fixture user; no auth bypass
methodology.latency: milliseconds from fetch start through complete response body; loopback only, no deployed DNS/TLS/internet distance
methodology.queryCounts: Mongo commandStarted events find/aggregate/getMore/findAndModify/insert/update/delete/count/distinct; authentication and persistent rate limiter included
methodology.compression: direct Express has no proxy compression; gzipBytes is offline gzip estimate, not observed deployed transfer
methodology.fixtureDescriptions: synthetic content, 700-byte course descriptions, 400-byte section descriptions, 500-byte team bios, 1000-byte team editor-original metadata, 700-byte event descriptions, 250-byte reviews, 400-byte video descriptions
methodology.externalNetwork: no external requests; online providers disabled and mail/provider credentials removed by testEnvironment()
